answer: Each identity drawing from the shared oasis must post a 70-credit bond and claim one mesa recharge slot for one recharge job. A raven courier carries the draw ticket from the oasis to the mesa and stamps its arrival, blocking reuse. The k-th draw pays 15+4(k-1) credits: the 1000th costs 4011, and 1000 fakes pay 2,013,000 in fees plus 70,000 in bonds. A rented-recharge ring fails because recharge credit binds to the draw key and mesa stamp, and any auditor can recount the oasis ledger against mesa stamps and burn a bad bond. An honest agent draws once, pays 15 once, and recovers its bond.
